observations: All twelve recorded Card preset/algorithm combinations and four Pan presets were operated and displayed their expected endpoints.
Keyboard ArrowRight changed zoom from 2 to 2.25 and view angle from 0 to 15 degrees.
A browser pointer press on the card centre with Choose pivot produced V (300,380).
Repeated Zoom times 1.5 requests at zoom 4 left pan unchanged: (12.35,-401.06) at angle 15 and target V (300,380).
Direct Card drag showed browser-generated trusted pointerdown, gotpointercapture, matching moves, pointerup and lostpointercapture. Its retained V point and target matched within 1e-12.
Final-build direct Pan drag continued beyond the SVG right edge, then completed and released capture. The card translation stayed (30,20).
Current browser mapping readback changed its client origin after scrolling; card-local roundtrip returned the retained local point to displayed precision.
375px screenshots showed readable upright Review and Target labels, neighbouring numerical outcome and controls, stacked displacement diagrams and no page overflow in both themes.
The final page had one In this article navigation and no captured console warnings or errors.
